title: Customers — Create & Edit alone lets a user change a customer's tiers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit' but not 'Settings — Parts'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  4. Pick tier A.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open Settings.
  7. Open Customers.
  8. Click New Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer shows Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier.

Step 3:

  • The picker lists the active tiers, tier A among them.

Step 4:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier A.

Step 5:

  • The customer saves with tier A for work orders.

Step 6:

  • Settings opens.
  • Its menu has no Pricing item.

Step 7:

  • The Customers list shows.

Step 8:

  • New Customer shows Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier on Default.
